name: JKTDC Chandigam Tourist Bungalow (caretaker dining)
signature_dish: tender chicken with Kashmiri sticky rice
why_it_matters: Lolab has no commercial restaurants — the JKTDC bungalow at Chandigam is the only kitchen in the valley. Ten rooms and a small dining room run by a resident caretaker (Hamid, per multiple traveller reports) who buys vegetables and chicken locally and cooks home-style. Outlook Traveller's Kupwara guide notes meals are 'prepared by the caretakers'.
insider_tip: Negotiate the meal price when you book the room — there's no menu and travellers report being overcharged otherwise. Reserve via the LBDDA office in Kupwara (01955-253335) or J&K Tourism Srinagar (0194-2479548); walk-ins risk a closed kitchen.
signature_address: JKTDC Tourist Bungalow, Chandigam, Lolab Valley, Kupwara, Jammu and Kashmir 193224

name: Satbarran Camping Site Cafeteria
why_it_matters: A six-room camping site near the Satbarran rock face at Khumriyal, with tents pitched on demand and a small cafeteria attached — the only food stop on the Kalaroos side of Lolab once you leave Sogam. Outlook Traveller documents it as part of the J&K Tourism camping circuit at ₹500 for a tent.
insider_tip: The cafeteria runs on whatever the caretaker has cooked that day — call the LBDDA office in Kupwara (01955-253335) the morning of your visit so they can stock chicken or egg. Otherwise it's parathas, dal, and Kashmiri tea.
signature_address: Satbarran, near Madmav village, Khumriyal, Lolab Valley, Kupwara, Jammu and Kashmir 193224
